sectors.label: Physical Development
sectors.ch_ref: v3 Ch5 Physical + For addition Ch5.1
sectors.goal: The goal of the physical plan is a flood resilient, connected and serviced municipality. Its purpose in the first phase is concrete, a bazaar that does not flood and fourteen wards that are all on the motorable network.
sectors.strategy: Flood proof the bazaar and connect the unserved wards, then standardise the corridor.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Physical goal/strategy lines; For addition.docx Ch5.1 for present-condition, SWOT, alternative analysis

sectors.label: Social Development
sectors.goal: The goal of the social plan is social services of equal quality across all wards. Its purpose in the first phase is a hospital with its specialists at post, a school estate matched to the children who actually exist, and a protection system that registers every birth and defends every girl.
sectors.strategy: Close the specialist staffing gap at Dhaulagiri Hospital and link women's skill training directly to the tourism and homestay value chain so that training converts into monetised, year round income.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Social goal/strategy; For addition.docx Ch5.2 LFA Goal (social service access, disparity index reduced by 2031) + Baglung_Municipality_SDP_IUDP_Report.docx (12ch evidence)

sectors.label: Environmental Management
sectors.ch_ref: v3 Ch5 Env + For addition Ch5.3
sectors.goal: The goal of the environmental plan is an environmentally balanced and climate resilient municipality. Its purpose in the first phase is a zero waste system running in all fourteen wards and an environmental record that finally has numbers.
sectors.strategy: Complete the hazard mapping and monitoring gap with GIS based disaster risk mapping for Wards 5, 6, 12 and 14, and scale the zero waste system to the eight wards still without formal collection.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Env goal/strategy; For addition.docx Ch5.3 (note: 5.3.8 DRR nested — normalize)

sectors.label: Disaster Risk Reduction
sectors.goal: The goal of the disaster plan is a disaster and climate resilient municipality. Its purpose in the first phase is that every ward knows its hazards, the two killer corridors carry early warning, and the building code has teeth.
sectors.strategy: GIS based disaster risk mapping for the high risk wards 5, 6, 12 and 14, linked to the evacuation system and the building code.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 DRR goal/strategy; For addition Ch5.3.8 if DRR content present — treat as DRR

sectors.label: Tourism Development
sectors.goal: The goal of the tourism plan is tourism revenue for the municipality and its people. Its purpose in the first phase is that the demand which already stands at Panchakot, the temple and the bridge begins paying wages, leases and royalties instead of passing through.
sectors.strategy: Convert existing visitor demand into overnight stays and municipal revenue by 2031 through concessions on the river, cliff and ridge.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Tourism goal/strategy + Ch5.5 product screens (8 products; A rafting, B bungy, C cable car to Ch7); report on homestay.docx Ch1-9; IUDP PROJECTS DESIGNS.docx P4/P5

sectors.label: Economic Development
sectors.ch_ref: v3 Ch5 Economic + For addition Ch5.4
sectors.goal: The goal of the economic plan is a resilient, competitive and inclusive local economy. Its purpose in the first phase is that the corridor wards begin processing what the hill wards already grow, and that Ward 2's trade dominance starts paying for the infrastructure it uses.
sectors.strategy: Ward 2 stays the commercial and logistics hub. Wards 3 and 4 become the secondary business districts. Wards 13 and 14 carry the agro processing clusters. Wards 5 to 12 feed the value chains from the farm.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Economic goal/strategy; For addition.docx Ch5.4.3 Goals/Objectives/Strategies (transform into self-sufficient high-value mid-hill economy; cold chain, homestay chain, youth/entrepreneurship, PPP transit routes)

sectors.label: Financial Development
sectors.ch_ref: v3 Ch5 Financial + Finance MSIP doc
sectors.goal: The goal of the financial plan is sustainable fiscal autonomy. Its purpose in the first phase is an own source revenue line growing fast enough to fund the plan's municipal share without betting on grants that keep shrinking.
sectors.strategy: Three moves. Pool the fragmented ward allocations into trunk projects. Commercialise the Davgara bus park to service its debt. Expand own source revenue with GIS property tax, PPP leasing and the riverbed levies.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Financial goal/strategy; Financial_Development_Plan_MSIP_IUDP_Format.docx Ch5.6 (5.6.1–5.6.10) numeric authority

sectors.label: Institutional Development
sectors.ch_ref: v3 Ch5 Institutional + For addition Ch5.5
sectors.goal: The goal of the institutional plan is a municipally led, technically capable government. Its purpose in the first phase is that the planning, GIS and PPP functions exist inside the municipality, because every flagship in this plan fails if it must be run forever by outside consultants.
sectors.strategy: Build the in house planning and GIS capacity so that the flagship projects become municipally led. Use the federal paperless governance budget of FY 2083/84 as the entry point.
sectors.source: v3 Ch5 Institutional goal/strategy; For addition.docx Ch5.5 (LFA hierarchy Goal/Purpose/Outputs/Activities; Alternative 4 integrated institutional strengthening 21/24)
